messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates C++ code to Python 3 code. The code should reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<translated_code>
import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    if n == 1:
        x = int(data[1])
        print(x)
        return
    s = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    s.sort()
    print(s[(n-1)//2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
